name: METOPROLOL 100 MG 50 TABLETS
description: Metoprolol is a beta-blocker medication used to treat heart disease and other conditions. Its main function is to relax blood vessels and slow the heart rate. This helps reduce high blood pressure, prevent or relieve the symptoms of angina, treat some cardiac arrhythmias, and, in some cases, even reduce the risk of death or hospitalization due to heart failure. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
